- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The heyday of French Art Deco was the 1920s to the 1930s, often referred to as the "Roaring Twenties."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] French Art Deco influenced furniture, architecture, jewelry, and fashion.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Designers like Émile-Jacques Ruhlmann and Jean-Michel Frank created exquisite furniture pieces in the Art Deco style.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Iconic Art Deco buildings include the Chrysler Building in New York City and the Palais de la Porte Dorée in Paris.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Art Deco jewelry is known for geometric shapes, bold colors, and luxurious materials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Designers like Coco Chanel and Elsa Schiaparelli incorporated Art Deco elements into their fashion designs.
